That changes the central estimand, probes, and token rather than clarifying the written procedure.

A nonlinear but invertible latent coordinate change can manufacture nonzero c under physically additive dynamics, so the token can drive paired action correction from representation curvature alone.

Wording the token as model-internal does not solve the anchor's need to distinguish real joint-action responsibility.
